18:   const {additionalLanguages} = prism as {additionalLanguages: string[]};
19: 
20:   // Prism components work on the Prism instance on the window, while prism-
21:   // react-renderer uses its own Prism instance. We temporarily mount the
22:   // instance onto window, import components to enhance it, then remove it to
23:   // avoid polluting global namespace.
24:   // You can mutate PrismObject: registering plugins, deleting languages... As
25:   // long as you don't re-assign it
26:   globalThis.Prism = PrismObject;

29:     // eslint-disable-next-line global-require, import/no-dynamic-require
30:     require(`prismjs/components/prism-${lang}`);

34: }
